reviews.text: I have been to this location twice, and each time I have encountered caring, thorough, knowledgeable and professional veterinarians and practitioners who care about their patients. And I just learned they have parking in the back. Win win!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Great and caring service.

I’ve been a Metro Vet customer for almost 10 years, and I honestly don’t know what has changed recently. This is no longer the Metro Vet experience I used to know. So many policies have changed without customers being notified, and many of my favorite doctors and technicians have left. What is going on?
Victoria was so incredibly kind to my pupper and me 🌸. We felt very safe here and cannot recommend Metropolitan Veterinary Center enough! …
Everyone at MetroVet is helpful and kind.  We truly appreciate all that they do to help our dogs stay healthy.

Would never recommend taking your pet here. Took my senior pup to Dr. Czapor to clean up a cut. During the visit she had horrible bedside manner and was quoting over 700 for work up. The vet tech who performed the cleaning was rude and clearly had not read her vet records which were sent before our visit. 2 weeks later, after antibiotics were finished, took her back for a follow up because she wasn’t eating or acting herself. After she had blood work I was told she had kidney failure and we needed to euthanize her. I asked if it was possible she still had the skin infection which was causing kidney values to go up and she said no.  I took her to VEG the next day after doing research because things didn’t add up. After a full work up she still had the skin infection that I was told was impossible after a round of antibiotics. I was also informed that the pain meds they prescribed during our initial visit were bad for kidneys and could have made things worse. Moreover, I requested her blood work the day off from Metro and it wasn’t sent until a day later only after VEG called them, albeit, a completely difference one from the one they sent to VEG.  Would not trust them ever again.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

The first time I was here with my pup Cielo was when she was 4 months old or so. It’s been six years now and they do such a great job with my lil girl.  Before Cielo, I had to jump around w vets w my other pup because they just didn’t meet my expectations. But what I love about metrovet is that it’s by appointment, they don’t make you wait long and how they truly take care of Cielo . I was just there few days ago and she’s still receiving the care she deserves. Thank you

Constantly trying to upsell. Very corporate. The vet was unwilling to give her opinion unless she gave my Dog $400 worth of tests.
She spent a total of three minutes with my dog, Wrote a prescription because I insisted and charged me 200. Most of my time was with a very nice  who vet tech Who is probably only making slightly more than minimum wage.

There is  a lot going on about the corporatization of the veterinary practice and my experience at this vet really exemplified this.
Found a tiny baby animal on the grass near the vet, trying to thrive… possibly a baby squirrel. We took it in to Metro to see if they could help. But they wanted nothing to do with it. Wow.

This may come across as petty, but it needs to be said.

First, though I love the new paint job around the office to really brighten up the space, replacing the previous, gorgeous pet photographs throughout the hospital with AI art feels skeevy as hell. It honestly left me feeling ill at ease, and I find it difficult to support a business that strips the human element from their business decor in lieu of dead-eyed, disproportional AI animals.

Second, I loved Dr Natarajan, who has unfortunately left the practice. My dog, who is a sweet, brave old man who fears no new experience, was so drooly and nervous to meet the new doctor that I was flabbergasted - he was so uncomfortable, and that certainly made me uncomfortable as well. I'm on the fence about finding a new vet office at this time.
Dr. C was very thorough with my senior dog during her new patient appointment.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Friendly and efficient! Treated my kitty like royalty.

I had a great experience here with Dr. Czapor! I appreciated how thoughtfully she answered all of my questions, and my cat felt comfortable during the visit. You can tell the staff is knowledgeable and dedicated to the animals!
Love the service and friendliness from all the staff.

Thank goodness for Dr. Jacobs and the other fantastic doctors and loyal staff at Metropolitan Veterinary Center! A new pup mom, I was nervous having my one year-old Shih Tzu go in for surgery... Dr. Jacobs consoled me providing complete details of the diagnosis and surgery... Staff called me immediately after surgery to let me know of the successful result/follow-up. First thing next morning who calls but  Dr. Jacobs herself to check on my little boy! Yes this is the kind of trusting open relationship with their vets I love and should be... No need to look elsewhere; bring your loving animals here especially if you're in the South Loop.

All of the people who work here are wonderful, and make it incredibly easy to get records for your pet, get medications for your pet, or whatever else your lil pal needs. Thank you all for being awesome!

This time my dog went into boarding and got stressed out with blood in his urine. Vet center got him straightened out with medication. He is always happy to see them!!! Which lets me know that they treat him well!!

I’ve been coming to MetroVet for the past few years for all three of my animals. They have always given us exceptional service and taking very good care of my animals (two cats and a dog). Besides getting exceptional care while we are there, whenever I have a question or concern, I can either call or email and they will reply to me asap. Thank you for caring for my animals.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

I have had nothing but an excellent experience each and every time I have taken my cat to Metropolitan Veterinary Center. Dr. Yates is exceptional and takes phenomenal care of my cat. The entire staff is friendly and always so helpful. The facility is clean and inviting for animals. I highly recommend this clinic for your animal care.

LOVE Metropolitan Veterinary Center. I have trusted them for years with my pup and while she might not love going to get her check-up, her fear subsides when they treat her like royalty! I would recommend them to any pet owner <3
The vets and associates are always friendly, caring and answer all our questions concerning our cats' care. We are very pleased with their professionalism.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

OUTSTANDING!! Our Doctor and Tech were amazing. I'm so glad we left the pretentious vet we were with in the West Loop and found Metropolitan Vet Center in the South Loop.  MVC is down to earth and  they treat our pet like he's family!

Took my dog here at the end of his life for treatment of his kidney failure. Couldn't get blood work results for a week because the vet assigned to me was on vacation. No other vet would talk to me. Totally uncaring that my dog was so sick and getting results quickly was imperative to his care. The next dog I adopted after my dog passed I just wanted them to check her spay scar with no other physical examination bc she just got out of the city pound and she's decompressing and she insisted on examining her, my dog mouthed her, dint bite and she said oh your dog tried to bite me. Well I told you not to do a physical examination touching her all over the place bc she's decompressing (she's a friendly pittie who loves people and no vet has had an issue with her since). Also tried to give me a vaccine that she'd already gotten even though she had the vac list from the shelter right in front of her face. Argued with me about dog food because she tried to tell me to feed my dog Purina bc "it's the best"  and I laughed. Fast forward a couple years and found out the X-rays I paid for at this vet were literally DOUBLE what I pay at the vet in my neighborhood who is actually considered more expensive than most. I wouldn't take my worst enemy here much less a beloved pet .

The prices are beyond outrageous. They are very thorough and kind to the animals, but expect a $500+ price tag for every visit. They wanted to charge me $1500+ for a teeth cleaning that will cost $500 at Banfield. I strongly recommend every Chicagoan drive to Indiana and establish care elsewhere, as the vets in the city are charging you three or four times what it costs in other places.

It's with a heavy heart that I write this review. My cat has been with Metropolitan for over a decade. However prospective clients need to know what they are signing up for.

The vets and vet techs are wonderful. This is not a review of their service or competence. This is a review of their business relationship with VetCove. VetCove operates Metropolitan's online pharmacy. Metropolitan will not prescribe to any other pharmacy. You may pick up a written prescription, but you will soon find there are no brick and mortar pet pharmacies in this area and it can take weeks for an online pharmacy to process a written prescription and get you the meds your pet needs.

Metropolitan will not send a prescription to another pharmacy even if their own pharmacy is out of stock of something your pet needs, even if it is in stock and available at another pharmacy. You will graciously be offered the option of picking up the meds at the clinic at a 100% to 1000% markup. If they do not have it in the clinic or their online shop then you can discuss alternative medications with the vet. This is an abuse and exploitation of a sick and vulnerable animal. To force a change in medication not out of medical necessity but because of a coercive business practice is deeply unethical and cruel.

If your pet has chronic conditions and you need to purchase meds regularly you will encounter this problem with some frequency.

I will not bring my pet to a vet that is willing to harm them in honor of a contract with VetCove. Furthermore, this contract is disrespectful and contemptuous of my rights as a consumer. Please understand that in this scenario you - the poor schmuck who pays the bill, you are no longer the customer. Metropolitan is the customer. You are merely an asset in a portfolio of assets that has been handed over to VetCove and you are forced to give them your money to get your pet the meds they need. Furthermore, VetCove has no incentive to provide good service to you because, again, you are no longer the customer, even though you are the one who pays the bill.

I hope this review will be useful to pet parents who are shopping for a new vet. I will be lodging a compliant with the IL attorney general to see if contracts such as these violate any consumer protection laws.

Edit to add : Their response below contains numerous lies or what I would call "dissembling euphemisms".  What they wrote - "Most — though not all — online pharmacies now require what’s called a wet signature prescription, meaning an original paper prescription with a doctor’s handwritten signature must be mailed to them." is an outright lie. Every online pharmacy I consulted accepts electronic prescriptions from a vet's office.

They "recommend" their own pharmacy because " it is the fastest". It is only the fastest because they refuse to submit any electronic prescriptions anywhere else, so you will be stuck with mailing paper prescriptions and wait weeks for the meds.

I am thoroughly disgusted by their dishonesty. I have taken my pet and my business somewhere where we can get a modicum of respect.
This is an incredible vet clinic. I highly recommend it. My pug loved the visit, and they are very attentive to patient needs!

ey ave max some fluids and some sublingual meds and sent us on our way. Doggie recovered the next day. They also sent me a text just to check up on the pup. Very professional. I highly recommend

Metropolitan Vet Center Dr. and Staff are great!  We had a visit to the vet on Saturday; my service dog had gotten into some of the omental grasses in Grant Park Sniffing!  and ended up with fox tail seeds embedded between his toes and junk in his eye!

The Dr. did a great job with the staff checking him out and pulling out the embedded fox tail seeds out of the webbing between his toes and check his eye for issues it was just irritated!  We recieved eye drops and a cream for between his toes to prevent infection and he turned around quickly!

What the Metropolitan Vet Center dose after every visit I really like is the follow up call from the Vet Tec. to make sure everything is going well with my dog and if I am having any issues with giving him the meds!  Great service and killer follow up!

I love the team at Metropolitan Veterinary Center!

They are responsive to questions and accommodating with appointment times. When I go there, they make me feel like they care as deeply for my pets as I do.

Our experience at Metropolitan Veterinary Center was nothing short of amazing. We’re new to Chicago and hadn’t yet found a regular vet for our dogs. When one of them got sick overnight, we needed to find someone who could see him right away. They answered immediately and were able to schedule a same-day appointment.

From the moment we arrived, the front desk staff was welcoming and efficient — we were greeted and brought to a room right away. Dr. Mitchell was lovely and thorough in her exam, answering all of our questions and reassuring us that our pup would be well cared for. Kayla, who worked alongside Dr. Mitchell, was an absolute joy to interact with — kind, attentive, and clearly caring toward our dog.

They walked us through their plan of care and were completely upfront and transparent about costs. There was no pressure for unnecessary tests, and they created a treatment plan that was both effective and cost-conscious.

If you’re looking for a vet in the area, I can’t recommend Metropolitan Veterinary Center enough. It was a 10/10 experience, and we’re so happy to have found such a wonderful place to bring our dogs.
I called the day prior and got an appointment for the next day. Convenience matters.

I walked home and my bunny enjoyed the beautiful day with a light breeze. I found my new vet!  Thanks Metro Vet Center.

I called the practice to see if they knew what route I could take to avoid the protest and was told they were not aware of any protest, that my vet was running behind schedule, but if I were 10-minutes late, my appointment would be cancelled. I was able to find a place to park two blocks  away, hustled with cat in tow, and made it 8-minutes after my appt, then had to wait for the vet in the exam room. I addressed this with the practice manager, who apologized on behalf of the way her supervisor handled my call.

Amazing staff, my dog used to get excited coming here. They didn’t try to push me to get anything unnecessary. They helped me enormously in getting expedited tests required for my pet’s travel overseas. Will miss this place. 5-stars!

We have always had a good experience here. This last experience was not that good. It left me feeling like they were taking advantage of a situation. My dog had a procedure. Every time I did a follow up with them they added a medication. The first time they charged me for follow-up medication it was 50 dollars for 14 pills for an antibiotic. They sell it on there online portal for 4 dollars. Then the second time 65 dollars for an ointment that they sell for 8 dollars on their online portal. This made me lose trust in the professionalism of this clinic. Why would you just add these items on a follow up appointment that was supposed to be free and outrageously over charge for it. When you sell the items 1/10th the price from your online pharmacy? It feels like you are taking advantage of trusting customers.

Can’t say enough wonderful things about MetroVet! My parents’ almost-14-year-old cat was experiencing significant appetite and weight loss, so I got her in for the soonest possible vet appointment (my parents had moved a year ago, and their old vet was a bit far). After trying a few places in the area that told me they couldn’t fit her in until next week, I gave MetroVet a call. They were able to see her the following day.

After a thorough exam of our very spicy kitty (they were gentle and patient and tried multiple different ways to take blood and fluid samples), Dr. Yates explained that our cat had a severe oral infection that affected her gums and teeth - and that she would need surgery right away. The vet tech went over the testing and medications administered that day and explained the x-rays, anesthesia, medications, and surgical procedures for her upcoming appointment the following Tuesday. Everyone was extremely patient, despite my parents being non-English-speaking and needing additional assistance with medication instructions.

Come the day of the surgery - we dropped her off at 7 AM. I received a call from Dr. Yates a couple of hours later informing me about the findings of the pre-op x-rays. Unfortunately, they found an aggressive form of bone cancer that had eaten away at Mao Mao’s jaw. It was terminal and expected to spread to other organs. She went over the options, and we agreed that putting her to sleep while she’s still under anesthesia was the best and most humane option to minimize her pain and suffering. I went over to the clinic a couple of hours later (after composing myself in the midst of the sudden and heartbreaking news). All the staff members were compassionate and offered their support. I took some time to say goodbye and let the grieve set in - and Dr. Yates administered the final heart-stopping shot.

Despite the difficult times, I have nothing but the best things to say about the doctors and staff at MetroVet. After the euthanasia, the team sent over my cat’s x-rays and were extremely kind and supportive. I ordered some memorial items for my cat - and they included fur clippings in a small bottle as a special memento. I checked my mail the same day and saw that they had sent me a card with messages from all of their staff members. They definitely went above and beyond, and I’ll never forget their very kind gestures during such difficult times.

Although I’ve only started going to MetroVet, their incredible kindness touched my heart! I highly recommend them and will 1000% be choosing them as my vet when I get another furry friend in the future. ❤️

Metro Vet was our primary veterinarian for Theo's eight years of life. The front desk and technicians were always friendly and seemed happy to care for Theo. The majority of the vets were good listeners and offered high quality care when Theo came in for his annual visit or illness.

Theo had a 7 month fight with a heart-based tumor where he received care at a specialty oncologist. When it came time to make final arrangements for Theo I utilized MV. The phone representative answered all the questions I had about the process and how his remains would be handled.

Dr. Abdel Mageed assured me that I was making the right decision for Theo. She was conversational and supportive.  I was given the time I needed to say good bye before and after the procedure. The staff all provided a personal message and signed a sympathy card I received in the mail. Sand they have been helpful providing the necessary documents for my insurance claim.

If I decide to get another furry companion, I will utilize MetroVet again.
